total.title: Total
total.description: The total number of visible squares (Set slider range: 1 to 8).

active.title: Active
active.description: Tracks which square is tapped (Set initial value to 0).

totalw.title: TotalW
totalw.description: Total width of the taskbar container (e.g., 720).

totalh.title: TotalH
totalh.description: Total height of the taskbar container (e.g., 200).

basecol.title: BaseCol
basecol.description: The background color of a functional app square (e.g., #FF2C2C2C).

altcol.title: AltCol
altcol.description: The darker color for the "Back" and "Reset/Blank" squares (e.g., #FF1A1A1A).

icon_vis.title: Icon_Vis
icon_vis.description: Icon Visibility: Set this to either true or false (all lowercase).

font_pdg.title: Font_Pdg
font_pdg.description: Font padding multiplier when Icon is visible.

font_max.title: Font_Max
font_max.description: Maximum size of the font field so that all textual objects fit neatly inside the provided squares.
font_max.value:
$mu(max, 
  tc(len, gv(app1_t)), 
  tc(len, gv(app2_t)), 
  tc(len, gv(app3_t)), 
  tc(len, gv(app4_t)), 
  tc(len, gv(app5_t)), 
  tc(len, gv(app6_t)), 
  tc(len, gv(app7_t)), 
  tc(len, gv(app8_t))
)$

max_wdth.title: Max_Wdth
max_wdth.description: The maximum physical horizontal space (in pixels) a text layer is allowed to occupy inside a square before it deforms.

r1_cols.title: R1_Cols
r1_cols.description: How many columns exist in their specific row at any given microsecond

r2_cols.title: R2_Cols
r2_cols.description: How many columns exist in their specific row at any given microsecond

internal_formulas.paint_color: $if(gv(active) = 0, gv(basecol), gv(active) = 1 | gv(tc(reg, "app1_htActive", "Active", gv(active))) = "", gv(altcol), gv(basecol))$

internal_formulas.position_padding_bottom: $if((gv(active) = 0 & gv(app1_icon) != "" & gv(app1_t) != "") | (gv(active) > 0 & gv(tc(reg, "app1_hiconActive", "Active", gv(active))) != "" & gv(tc(reg, "app1_htActive", "Active", gv(active))) != ""), ((gv(totalh) - (gv(rows) + 1)) / gv(rows)) * 0.20, 0)$

internal_formulas.position_padding_top: $if(gv(Icon_Vis) = "true" & ((gv(active) = 0 & gv(app1_icon) != "" & gv(app1_t) != "") | (gv(active) > 0 & gv(tc(reg, "app1_hiconActive", "Active", gv(active))) != "" & gv(tc(reg, "app1_htActive", "Active", gv(active))) != "")), ((gv(totalh) - (gv(rows) + 1)) / gv(rows)) * gv(Font_Pdg), 0)$
